name: Rampaging Yao Guai

Vigilance, trample
This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
When this creature enters, destroy any number of target artifacts and/or enchantments with total mana value X or less.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, destroy any number of target artifacts and/or enchantments with total mana value X or less.

needs.what: a target spec's `total_mana_value` cap that takes a value (the X paid to cast the permanent, read by its own enters trigger, e.g. {"x": true}) instead of only a printed integer, so an any-number target's picks together are limited to mana value X or less
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The target key `total_mana_value` exists (Phoenix, Warden of Fire) but is typed `int | None` in the schema and loader, so only a constant cap like 6 can be written; a per-candidate `mana_value` selector clause caps each pick separately, which is a much wider card
